_comment: Maps Archipelago ItemInfo.ItemId -> in-game action. Auto-loaded from the app dir; override with --items <path>. See apitems.sample.json for the full format.
_comment_sectors: The AP world's three sector items are real 0x49-tagged sector GIDs, but a sector is not a grantable inventory entity. Each drives two things: a "bit" (what the elevator panel offers) and a GameFlow "flag" (whether the game permits the trip once a floor is chosen). Executive is deliberately absent — the game forces it available and the UI patch leaves it always-enabled, since locking the player out of the hub risks a softlock. Investigation is already gated by the patch but has no AP item until the DLC.
_comment_maintenance: Maintenance Sector drives BOTH maintenance entries. Lobby and Pump Room (the 'Maintenance Access Corridor') reach the same content, so gating only Lobby would leave a permanent back door.
_comment_bits: "bits" REQUIRE the UI patch (tools/Ap.Control.Patcher, `apply elevator`) — without it they are written but nothing reads them. Stock, the panel derives its floor list from ONE integer = the highest unlocked sector index, which makes the sectors a strict ladder (Maintenance implies Research) and hardcodes Pump Room and Executive as always available. Patched, it reads five independent booleans the client writes into a Coherent UI model. Those same bytes are the control-point 'new' badge flags, so the game overwrites them for its own reasons — hence ArchipelagoClient re-asserts them on a 100 ms timer, and reconciles the GameFlow flags on a 1 s timer rather than only on save.
_comment_clearance: Clearance needs no entry: the world mints its ids as (n << 8) | 0x49 -- 329/585/841/1097/1353/1609 for fixed Levels 1-6, 1865 for Progressive Clearance Level -- and the client resolves both from the id (Utils/ApClearanceIds.cs).
